verdict.rationale: Tailscale manages connectivity centrally. A single tailnet policy file, edited through the visual policy editor, governs access across the whole mesh, and Tailscale SSH centralizes SSH authentication and authorization, so connection rules effectively follow every device on the tailnet. The evidence never explicitly describes syncing saved hosts or per-user client connection settings between devices, so this is an inference from the centralized design rather than a documented feature. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of synced host lists or bookmarks, per-device client settings sync, offline behavior of the synced config, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
